title: S.I.T.E.S Site Manifest
description: Declarative spec for assembling a S.I.T.E.S site: a plate (site + theme + nav) composed of an ordered array of modular tiles. Validating this manifest is the contract an AI agent satisfies before emitting HTML/CSS/JS.

layout.description: How the page lays its tiles out. 'auto' is the automatic auto-fit grid: tiles flow into as many equal columns as fit and per-tile spans do nothing. 'cols' is the configured 12-column grid (6 narrow) where each entry's layout.span applies. The scaffolding shells read this; the binder and baker apply the spans.

plate.description: The background behind everything. Applied by the binder at load and by tools/bake.mjs at build time, so a page with JavaScript disabled looks identical — the background is the first thing painted and must not depend on a script. 'animation' drifts the ambient wash and degrades to the same static wash under prefers-reduced-motion.

mode.description: 'ambient' is the two radial washes, which follow the theme tokens. 'color' is a flat plate. 'image' puts an image behind everything. 'animation' drifts the ambient wash. 'none' removes the layer entirely.

color.description: Used by 'color' (and available to the others). Any CSS colour, so a theme token's value or an explicit colour both work.

image.description: Used by 'image'. A path, a URL, or 'asset:<key>' to resolve through the asset map like a tile image.

ogImage.description: Legacy alias of seo.image, kept so existing content files stay valid.

image.description: Social share image (og:image / twitter:image) — 1200x630 raster, absolute or site-relative against baseUrl. Optional: without it no og:image is emitted.

noindex.description: Keep the WHOLE site out of search results — the pre-launch state. When true, tools/seo.mjs writes <meta name="robots" content="noindex"> into every page's SEO block, stops advertising sitemap.xml in robots.txt, and removes sitemap.xml. robots.txt stays crawlable on purpose: a Disallow stops the crawler fetching the page, so it never reads the noindex tag and the URL can stay indexed. A SITE setting rather than a per-page tag, because the decision is 'this site is not ready to be found', not 'this page differs from its neighbours'. Remove it (or set false) to go live; page-level noindex tags still work and are independent.

pages.description: OPTIONAL per-page metadata keyed by page path ('/', '/tiles.html'). Without an entry, tools/seo.mjs derives the title from that page's first headline and the description from its body copy, then falls back to seo.title / seo.description.

business.description: OPTIONAL local-business details. When present, tools/seo.mjs emits an additional LocalBusiness JSON-LD node beside the WebSite node — the highest-leverage artifact for local search and AI answer engines. Omit it and the site emits WebSite-only JSON-LD (docs/SEO.md).

address.description: Emitted as a schema.org PostalAddress. Any subset may be given.

geo.description: Emitted as schema.org GeoCoordinates. Both values must be numbers.

theme.description: Design tokens. Every color/radius/shadow should map to a token.

colors.description: LIGHT palette: maps to --color-<key>. e.g. { "primary": "#1E4D4F" } -> --color-primary. Accepts hex, rgb()/rgba(), hsl()/hsla(), color-mix(), transparent.

dark.description: DARK palette overrides, emitted under [data-theme="dark"]. Any color key omitted falls back to the light value.

assets.description: Logical asset map: key -> path or Firebase Storage token URL. Pages may reference 'asset:<key>'. Populated by the admin uploader in firebase asset mode.

icon.description: Optional inline SVG name / path hint.

content.description: Ordered sections; each becomes a tile in the plate.

type.description: Tile type — one of the catalog names.

variant.description: tile-<type>--<variant> modifier, applied to the tile root by the binder at load and by tools/bake.mjs at build time. The variants a type offers are declared in src/js/tile-registry.js (SITES.tileVariants) and check-site fails on one that is not declared or has no CSS.

panel.description: What goes inside this tile's box. A tile is always a rectangular panel on the grid — padding and a radius so it cannot collide with its neighbour — and this picks the fill. Omit it for a box you cannot see: padding and radius, no fill, so the content appears to sit on the background. 'surface' is the raised card treatment, 'accent' is a soft tint of the accent colour for visual pop, and 'none' removes the box entirely (no padding, no radius, no fill). Applied by the binder at load and tools/bake.mjs at build time.

css.description: A small block of CSS for this tile alone: DECLARATIONS ONLY, no selector. The framework scopes it for you by wrapping it in [data-tile-id="<id>"], collected with every other tile's block into one site-level <style> by the binder at load and by tools/bake.mjs at build time. Enforced by SITES.cssLint: no braces (a brace would close the scope and the rest would become page-wide CSS), no at-rules, no angle brackets, and no hardcoded colours — rule 3 means var(--token) only, so a tile survives a re-theme and dark mode.

layout.description: Grid placement, applied by the binder at load and by tools/bake.mjs at build time. Only meaningful when the tile container is in configured mode (.sites-grid--cols); in automatic mode a span does nothing and check-site reports it.

span.description: Columns to span in the wide tier (12-column grid).

spanSm.description: Columns to span in the narrow tier (6-column grid).

start.description: Explicit column start in the wide tier.

config.description: Tile-specific config. Left open per type; validated by convention/per-tile schemas.

provider.description: Embeddable-service provider key for tool tiles.

endpoint.description: Service endpoint (form action, calendar url, etc.).

keys.description: Service-specific id/keys (map center, search index, sku).
